facts.label: Told me e said
facts.sub: Told me + frase no passado. Said + frase no passado. Is → was, will → would, can → could.

facts.label: Me disse
facts.sub: Use told com a pessoa: She told me she was nervous. Depois de told, diga quem ouviu: me, him, her, us. O that é opcional. O verbo seguinte fica no passado.

facts.label: Disse
facts.sub: Use said sem a pessoa: She said she was nervous. Não diga said me. Se quiser a pessoa, use said to me, mas told me é mais comum. O verbo da frase volta um passo.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “She told me she was nervous” is correct.
We say “She said me she was nervous”.
items.why: We say She told me or She said.

items.s: Am becomes was in reported speech.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “She told me she was nervous” is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “She said me she was nervous”. → Falso (We say She told me or She said.)
Am becomes was in reported speech. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: News about a friend · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny afternoon in Denver. Emma and Amara walk near a big park. Their friend Sara had a job interview today. Emma wants to know how it went. Amara talked with Sara in the morning. Now she tells Emma the whole story.
“Did you talk to Sara after her job interview, Amara?” says Emma. “Yes. She told me she was very nervous that morning.” says Amara. “Really? She said she felt ready last week.” says Emma.
